policy.advisory_only: An observation only records what the advisor said; it never blocks production.
policy.not_authority: An observation record is derived experience, never episode state or story gate authority.
policy.lifecycle: OBSERVED -> FEEDBACK_PENDING -> COMPLETED; a transition is a new ledger row, not an edit.
policy.no_score: The ledger records status, references and free text; it never records a similarity score.
policy.human_triggered: Rows are written only when a human runs the observation runner or the feedback entry.
